title: SEBI floats proposal to revamp ETF price band framework
summary: SEBI proposed shifting ETF base price from T-2 closing NAV to T-1 data/iNAV with dynamic price bands (10-20% equity/debt, 6-20% gold/silver, 5% overnight).
